description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment (S96a) to planning permission Ref:181380FUL Dated 22.12.2021 for 'Demolition of existing structures and residential-led, mixed use redevelopment to provide four buildings ranging in height from 15 to 23 storey's comprising residential (575 units), 2,100 sq m of B1(a) office floorspace, 449 sq m of flexible commercial floorspace (Use Classes A1, A2, A3, B1a and D1), erection of a boundary wall along the railway line, along with landscaping, play and amenity space, cycle parking, servicing bays, plant and refuse areas, and new access arrangements (REVISED PROPOSAL DESCRIPTION).'. Amendments to the internal layout to enable provision of a ground-floor residents amenity within building 3 with associated change to description of development; ground floor layout changes to building 4 including updated building 4 PEX location and updated cycle storage layout numbers within building 4; update to the design of the building 'crowns'; entrance design updates and further Minimal elevational changes.
